categories.title: The Tide That Turned
categories.description: The main story, mark by mark. The sea keeps this list itself.

categories.title: The Quay
categories.description: The people of Greywater, and where you stand with them.

categories.title: The Water
categories.description: Races, slaloms, dives, storms, fish, rescues, and the reach wardens.

categories.title: Tides and Salt
categories.description: The long game: runs, wrecks, pearls, renown, and the years.

categories.description: The Drowned Almanac, page by page.

categories.title: Deep Cuts
categories.description: Marks the sea makes quietly, for those who were paying attention.

achievements.name: Tideborn
achievements.description: Set out on your first tide. The sea threw you back; make it wonder why.

achievements.name: Rule One of My Harbor
achievements.description: Take the loaner skiff's papers. Nobody drowns hungry.

achievements.name: The Man Drowning in Paper
achievements.description: Meet Nereus, and the book the sea has been mailing him for nineteen years.

achievements.name: Your Own Hand
achievements.description: Sit in the Brinehouse and read proof, in your own handwriting, of who the sea gave back.

achievements.name: One Hundred and Forty Steps
achievements.description: Climb the lighthouse stair. The first step is the hard one.

achievements.name: A Man of His Word
achievements.description: Promise the Keeper you will finish the rescue. It just runs a little behind schedule.

achievements.name: The Column Headed JANE
achievements.description: Hear Odessa say what her sixteen-year-old self knew off the tide line in one look.

achievements.name: Punctual as Grief
achievements.description: Cross the Pale Ferry's wake and read the name streaming down her stern board.

achievements.name: She Waits
achievements.description: Learn what the Pale Ferry has been running her route for, all these years.

achievements.name: The Index Found
achievements.description: Learn what the Leviathan circles, and why the sea could not let it rot.

achievements.name: Raising the Lantern Jane
achievements.description: It takes the whole quay, which is the only way anything true gets done on a coast.

achievements.name: The Lamp Never Went Out
achievements.description: Carry the Keeper's message for the girl the sea kept young.

achievements.name: About a Red Coat
achievements.description: Carry Mirabel's message down her thread into the water.

achievements.name: Into the Glass Squall
achievements.description: Sail the Jane into the place every voice in this water has been waiting on.

achievements.name: The Thirty-First Soul
achievements.description: Finish the rescue. She took forever to be collected, and no time at all.

achievements.name: Twice Offered
achievements.description: Offer the sea yourself in her place, again, and hear it laugh like surf on a kind shore.

achievements.name: What the Key Opens
achievements.description: Open, at very long last, the small brass lock the sea sent you home wearing.

achievements.name: Rung Properly
achievements.description: Once for the harbor, once for the boat, and once, quietly, for the water. Unrushed.

achievements.name: Lesson One
achievements.description: Take on the coast's most determined apprentice, on her father's terms.

achievements.name: Every Thread Home
achievements.description: After the Squall exhales, hear the ending from every one of them: the ledger, the coat, the record, the trophies, the last page, and the lamp.

achievements.name: Undertaker's Receptionist
achievements.description: Meet Odessa, harbormaster of Greywater Quay, who counts everything twice.

achievements.name: The Stove Decides
achievements.description: Meet Mirabel and accept the verdict. It is the chowder, and it is correct.

achievements.name: The Man by the Window
achievements.description: Meet Brick, six years champion, whose trophies face away from the water.

achievements.name: Mine to Beat
achievements.description: Be formally claimed as a rival by the fastest thing on this coast.

achievements.name: No Whistling
achievements.description: Meet Sefton and learn the rules of the shop. Especially you: no whistling.

achievements.name: The Second Chair
achievements.description: Earn the chair beside Odessa's desk instead of in front of it.

achievements.name: The Bar End Seat
achievements.description: Hold the place at the Brinehouse bar that the unwritten ledger says is yours.

achievements.name: Buoy by Buoy
achievements.description: Be worth the old champion's coaching, eyes closed, gate by gate.

achievements.name: Steadier Than the Gull
achievements.description: Become the assistant Nereus's archive deserves. The gull remains on staff.

achievements.name: Worth Studying
achievements.description: Graduate, in Cass Veyle's formal taxonomy, from rival to subject of research.

achievements.name: Invoice Goes to the Sea
achievements.description: Reach the standing Sefton reserves for people whose knots he ties free.

achievements.name: The Kettle Knows You
achievements.description: Climb the stair often enough that the tea is poured before you knock.

achievements.name: Logged Out, Home by Supper
achievements.description: Be the standing arrangement in an eleven-year-old's extremely well-kept log.

achievements.name: Boards Dry, Lines Free
achievements.description: Become, in the harbormaster's exacting books, family.

achievements.name: Family at the Stove
achievements.description: Become someone the Brinehouse stove has permanent opinions about.

achievements.name: The Foghorn on the Wall
achievements.description: Become the reason the old champion stands the sea wall at dawn, alive again.

achievements.name: Fellow Professional
achievements.description: Earn the second loupe on the corner table.

achievements.name: Rival, Permanent
achievements.description: Become the fixed point Cass Veyle measures the whole water by.

achievements.name: Knotted In
achievements.description: Wear enough of Sefton's work that the sea files you under his account.

achievements.name: Standing Orders
achievements.description: Earn the promise: whatever the sea wants next, an old man holds the light on you.

achievements.name: Her Light Rides Home
achievements.description: Whatever else swims.

achievements.name: Year Seven
achievements.description: Hear what Brick heard in the water, forty minutes down, politely waiting.

achievements.name: The Cheapest Theater on the Coast
achievements.description: Run the dawn slalom while the old champion works the stopwatch and the foghorn.

achievements.name: Speaking Terms
achievements.description: Come home to find Brick on the water, sitting the chop, not making it a thing.

achievements.name: Under His Own Name
achievements.description: Countersign the entry form: BRYK MOLENAAR, veterans' class, second attached.

achievements.name: Off the Page
achievements.description: Learn Ren's chowder in Mirabel's kitchen, thyme off the heat, always off the heat.

achievements.name: An Installment
achievements.description: Learn what the free chowder was all along.

achievements.name: Four Hundred and Two
achievements.description: Hand Nereus back his slate and watch him take the ladder before the cold can argue.

achievements.name: Greywater, Living
achievements.description: Give the first interview to the new book. The land keeps records now too.

achievements.name: The Folk Song, Footnoted
achievements.description: Let Cass's research catch up with what the coast's records always said.

achievements.name: One More Minute
achievements.description: Teach the fastest thing on the coast to cut her engine and hear the second set of books.

achievements.name: Beaten Fair
achievements.description: Lose the rematch to a racer who heard the wake before it arrived. Confirm you didn't ease.

achievements.name: Storm Tithe
achievements.description: Beat weather, and carry the knot of the weather you beat.

achievements.name: Three Bangs, Not Two
achievements.description: Carry twenty years of a family's weather from a shop counter to a beacon rail.

achievements.name: The Season Turns
achievements.description: Bring the brothers back into one room, cribbage board and all.

achievements.name: Long, Long, Short
achievements.description: Learn the lamp code from the man who answered it across eleven miles of black water.

achievements.name: Flotsam, Addressed
achievements.description: Bring up a keepsake from the green dark: something the sea kept, because it was somebody's.

achievements.name: Met at the Dock
achievements.description: Carry a keepsake home to the person it remembers.

achievements.name: The Sea's Courier
achievements.description: Deliver every keepsake the water has to give back. The chest's ledger closes settled.

achievements.name: First Across the Line
achievements.description: Win a boat race, wake still settling.

achievements.name: I Don't Lap Traffic
achievements.description: Win five races. Cass has started a file.

achievements.name: Regatta Material
achievements.description: Win fifteen races. The spectators say your name like they're checking a fact.

achievements.name: Try to Lose Honestly
achievements.description: Win thirty races. The Persimmon's helmswoman rests her case.

achievements.name: The Buoy Line
achievements.description: Clear your first slalom.

achievements.name: Carved Clean
achievements.description: Clear five slaloms. Brick has opinions about your fifth gate. He is right.

achievements.name: A Ski You Argue With
achievements.description: Clear fifteen slaloms. You have learned the difference between sailing and arguing.

achievements.name: Six Years Running
achievements.description: Clear thirty slaloms. Somewhere, a wall of trophies approves.

achievements.name: The Green Dark
achievements.description: Complete your first dive salvage.

achievements.name: Mind the Second Layer
achievements.description: Complete five dives. The cold is a liar there, and you have stopped listening.

achievements.name: Look Behind the Wreck
achievements.description: Complete fifteen dives. The sea files things behind; you check.

achievements.name: A Diver's Tally
achievements.description: Complete thirty dives. Somewhere there is a slate that would respect this number.

achievements.name: Through Weather
achievements.description: Survive your first storm crossing.

achievements.name: The Rematch Never Comes
achievements.description: Survive five storms. Your jacket is a knot museum.

achievements.name: The Weather Did Not Win
achievements.description: Survive fifteen storms. The squalls have started going around.

achievements.name: Silver Over the Rail
achievements.description: Land your first fish.

achievements.name: First Refusal to the Kitchen
achievements.description: Land ten fish. The stove has decided it likes you.

achievements.name: The Scales Know You
achievements.description: Land twenty-five fish. The scalemaster says your totals twice, once for theater.

achievements.name: The Fish Have a Betting Pool
achievements.description: Land fifty fish. It is quay-official: they bet against themselves.

achievements.name: A Whistle on the Water
achievements.description: Haul your first soul out of the chop. Most boats log it as wind. You didn't.

achievements.name: Louder Than Wind
achievements.description: Rescue five souls. Word of a rescue travels farther than any race result.

achievements.name: The Patrol Gave Up First
achievements.description: Rescue fifteen souls. The launches have started saving fuel by following you.

achievements.name: Beam-On, for Strangers
achievements.description: Rescue thirty souls. Somebody once did this nine times in one night. It runs in the hands.

achievements.name: Reach Warden
achievements.description: Beat your first warden at the edge of deeper water.

achievements.name: The Edge of Deeper Water
achievements.description: Beat five wardens. The reaches have started being polite about it.

achievements.name: The Deep Stands Aside
achievements.description: Beat fifteen wardens. The deep water schedules around you now.

achievements.name: Past the Sandbars
achievements.description: Clear the Shallows and open the way to the Chop.

achievements.name: Through the Chop
achievements.description: Clear the Chop, where the ferries and the folk songs run.

achievements.name: The Drowned Forest
achievements.description: Clear Wreckwater, under the standing masts, over the patient trench.

achievements.name: Where the Squall Stands
achievements.description: Go all the way in, to the town at the bottom of the light.

achievements.name: Five Tides
achievements.description: Set out five times. Odessa leaves the harbor mouth lit a little later now.

achievements.name: Counting in Water
achievements.description: Set out ten times. You've stopped counting in days.

achievements.name: Lost Count, Kept Going
achievements.description: Set out twenty-five times, which the old hands say is when the sea starts trusting you.

achievements.name: The Blood Was Always Seawater
achievements.description: Set out fifty times. The land is the thing you visit.

achievements.name: A Hundred Tides
achievements.description: Set out one hundred times. The quay tells time by you.

achievements.name: Catch Lashed Down
achievements.description: Come home from your first tide with the light failing kindly.

achievements.name: Regular
achievements.description: Come home ten times. There is a mooring that has quietly become yours.

achievements.name: Your Cleat, Your Ring
achievements.description: Come home twenty-five times. Nobody else touches your coil of line.

achievements.name: The Harbor Holds You
achievements.description: Come home fifty times, the way harbors are for.

achievements.name: Postage Due
achievements.description: Wreck, and wake on the shingle anyway. The sea is keeping score of what it lends you.

achievements.name: A Habit of Not Drowning
achievements.description: Wreck three times. Sefton touches wood when you pass, then apologizes to the wood.

achievements.name: Your Own Column
achievements.description: Wreck five times and earn a page in the section insurance doesn't believe in.

achievements.name: The Sea's Own Customer
achievements.description: Wreck ten times. You have a mooring down there as well as up here.

achievements.name: A Heavy Purse
achievements.description: Hold one hundred pearls at once.

achievements.name: Rich and Angry in Equal Parts
achievements.description: Hold three hundred pearls at once. The sea around here pays well; you collect.

achievements.name: Winched Aboard
achievements.description: Bring up one hundred lifetime salvage.

achievements.name: Everything Ever Winched
achievements.description: Bring up five hundred lifetime salvage, banked or lost. The ledger remembers both.

achievements.name: Known at the Scales
achievements.description: Reach renown level two.

achievements.name: Word Travels Inland
achievements.description: Reach renown level four. Word like yours travels faster than weather.

achievements.name: Folk Song Material
achievements.description: Reach renown level six. Somebody has started rhyming things with 'tideborn.'

achievements.name: No Higher Rank to Give
achievements.description: Reach the top of the coast's regard. The rest is legend maintenance.

achievements.name: Choices at the Dock
achievements.description: Own three vessels.

achievements.name: The Whole Yard
achievements.description: Own every hull this coast can offer you. One of them cannot be bought.

achievements.name: Half the Wall
achievements.description: Own four pieces of Sefton's permanent stock.

achievements.name: Sefton's Best Customer
achievements.description: Own the chandlery's entire permanent stock. He rings it up wrong, in your favor, once.

achievements.name: Tide Marks
achievements.description: Raise the water after your victory and go out again anyway.

achievements.name: Higher Water
achievements.description: Sail at Tide Mark three. The sea asks more because it knows you have it.

achievements.name: Salt-Proof
achievements.description: Sail at Tide Mark five. There is nothing left the water can ask that you haven't answered.

achievements.name: The Sea's Post
achievements.description: Recover your first page of the Drowned Almanac.

achievements.name: Coming In Over a Beach
achievements.description: Recover ten pages. The Almanac gets everyone who touches it.

achievements.name: The Better Postage
achievements.description: Recover twenty-five pages. The town is ten thousand mornings, and they keep arriving.

achievements.name: Nearly Bound
achievements.description: Recover forty pages. Nereus has started pricing oiled canvas for the binding.

achievements.name: The Whole Town, Posted
achievements.description: Recover every page the sea has to send. The post office closes complete.

achievements.name: Thirty-One
achievements.description: On your first morning, lie still a moment longer, and hear the number under the tide.

achievements.name: Old Pattern
achievements.description: Ask Odessa about the key before you know enough to be afraid of the answer.

achievements.name: The Committee of One
achievements.description: Take Bosun aboard and pass inspection.

achievements.name: Witnessed by Gulls
achievements.description: Chalk your time on the challenge buoy, alone, in chop, which the slate does not record.

achievements.name: Take Your Bell
achievements.description: Find what a dry shelf held for nineteen years, a year and a day be hanged.

achievements.name: Received. Coming.
achievements.description: Answer the glass calm on the rail, and be shown off for by somebody far below.

achievements.name: In Good Standing
achievements.description: Earn the sea's grace three times over. It keeps accounts of courtesy too.

achievements.name: Full Honors
achievements.description: Be saluted, vessel to vessel, by the sea itself, on a fair afternoon built for goodbyes.

achievements.name: Home by Supper
achievements.description: Wash up on the shingle and into the jurisdiction of the coast's smallest tribunal.

achievements.name: No Paperwork
achievements.description: Trade at the raft market, out past patrol range, where the gap between hulls is the notary.

achievements.name: Her Wheel, Your Hands
achievements.description: Take the Lantern Jane to sea under your own hands, while the whole quay pretends not to watch.

achievements.name: Seen You. Welcome Back.
achievements.description: Sail her over the town she served, and be answered window by window.
